the-net: Rex Beach, the bestselling author of The Spoilers, spins a novel of intrigue and high-stakes scheming. His hero is drawn into a web of plotters where money, power, and a woman's honor hang in the balance. Beach's muscular, fast-moving style made him one of America's most popular storytellers, and this tale delivers the adventure his readers expected.
the-little-nugget: P. G. Wodehouse's early comic novel centers on Ogden Ford — the Little Nugget — a monstrously spoiled child heir whom various parties plot to kidnap. Enter Sam Fisher, tutor and reluctant schemer, in a tangle of abductions and romance. The master's light touch is already evident in this fast, funny romp.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-frig: A 1913 entry on Frigolet, the Provençal abbey among the pines. Mistral's wind sings through its cloister. Francis Martin Geudens tells its tale. Southern France in monastic dress. Alphonse Daudet set his tales among its hills. Pilgrims climb its hill for the August pardon.
